newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotel shares sustain Mauritius market index.
newsitem.headline: Hotel shares sustain Mauritius market index.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse index, Semdex gained 1.59 points to 368.49 on Monday, sustained by rising shares in the hotel sector, dealers said.
Turnover was posted at 9.36 million rupees on 286,060 shares from 20.67 million rupees on 728,198 shares on Friday.

Amid falling shares of several smaller companies on the list, rising stock prices of hotel concerns Sun Resorts, New Mauritius Hotels and Grand Baie Hotel offset the downward trend and sustained the Semdex on Monday, dealers said.
"Foreign investors injected some activity in the market and especially in Sun Resorts. Otherwise, it would have been a quiet session," one dealer said.
Sun Resorts surged 2.50 rupees to 44.60 on 40,910 shares, New Mauritius Hotels gained 20 cents to 34.20 rupees on 10,986 shares and Grand Baie Hotel was up 30 cents to 41.70 rupees on 2,200 shares.
"Fortunately, foreigners are buying the blue chips stocks and this is providing support to the market both in terms of the Semdex level and trading volume," the dealer added.

Investment based Belle Mare Holdings (BMH) was also seen as a target of foreign investors trading owing to its high volume. BMH, the most actively traded stock on Monday, rose 20 cents to 50 rupees on 50,907 shares.
Mauritius Commercial Bank lost 50 cents to 85.50 rupees on 15,000 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 11.10 rupees on 53,850 shares.
Mauritius Breweries remained at 135 rupees on 5,682 shares and sugar based Mon Tresor Mon Desert climbed 40 cents to 38.90 rupees on 5,675 shares.

Investment based Promotion and Development (PAD) was 50 cents down to 15.40 rupees on 34,374 shares and National Investment Trust (NIT) eased 10 cents to 12.30 rupees on 9,400 shares. Rogers was unchanged at 99 rupees on 545 shares and Ireland Blyth was stable at 14.50 rupees on 7,550 shares.
Commerce-based Courts lost 15 cents to 5.10 rupees on 4,000 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius was 10 cents lower to 43.90 rupees on 670 shares.
